messages.en_US: It’s a replica of an ancient Pokémon.

en_US: Hmm.
I have been studying the ruins for many
years, but something feels...
different.
Wow!
The UNOWN pictures on the wall...
It feels like they’re staring at me!
What is this?
There is something eerie that is making
my legs shiver.
I can’t stop them!
Oh, are you all right?
You disappeared right in front of me,
and that made me so surprised!
I see.
The power of ARCEUS and UNOWN affected
each other to create a huge energy,
which sent you to the Sinjoh Ruins...?
UNOWN, the Ruins of Alph, and ARCEUS...
The mystery deepens...
It has made me even more inquisitive!
I will one day solve all the mysteries!
